title: Panorama of Spiral Galaxy, M31
publisher: NSF NOIRLab (Local Group Survey), with ESA/Hubble in the gaps
credit: Local Group Survey Team and T.A. Rector (University of Alaska Anchorage)/NOIRLab/NSF/AURA; outer disc: ESA/Hubble & Digitized Sky Survey 2, acknowledgment Davide De Martin (ESA/Hubble)

checkedSource.kind: Composite of the survey panorama and the DSS2 view (packages/bake/authoring/m31/compose-optical.mts)

geometryEvidence.reference: Inclination: Dorman et al. 2013 (disc ellipticity 0.725, thin-disc limit); line of nodes: Chemin, Carignan & Foster 2009, arXiv:0909.3846

displayModel: The photograph's light is split by a published bulge-plus-disc fit (Dorman et al. 2013): the disc's share is decomposed by local compactness into one midplane residual and a diffuse component spread through 32 slabs with an exponential profile of 342 pc (Braun 1991's gas layer at 10 kpc); the bulge's share is spread through an oblate spheroid sliced in every bank. Depth is modelled, not measured per pixel.
coverage: The survey strip covers the disc along the major axis; the DSS2 view fills its notches and the outer disc to the 27.2 kpc support. Milky Way foreground stars (Gaia DR3), M32 and NGC 205 are removed; fainter and uncatalogued stars remain.

acquisition.operation: packages/bake/authoring/m31/compose-optical.mts: resample the survey Large JPEG and the heic1112f crop into one gnomonic frame (centre on M31, north 125.8 deg right of vertical, 4.2 x 1.4 deg at 2 arcsec per pixel); histogram-match the DSS2 light to the survey's per channel where both cover; fade the two over 2 arcmin inside the mosaic's edge; encode JPEG quality 92 with 4:4:4 chroma.

fill.title: Wide-field view of the Andromeda Galaxy
fill.credit: ESA/Hubble & Digitized Sky Survey 2. Acknowledgment: Davide De Martin (ESA/Hubble)

checkedSource.kind: High-resolution crop/resample derived offline from the publisher Large JPEG

acquisition.operation: Decode publisher JPEG, extract parent pixels [6000,1000,11000,11500], resize to 4783x5000 with Lanczos3, encode JPEG quality 95 with 4:4:4 chroma (sharp 0.35.3).
